dashboard.welcome: Welcome, {name}. Tell us what you want to make and we'll plan it with you.

dashboard.atCap: You've made as many apps as your plan allows.

dashboard.createHelp: Start a new app from a template, a website you own, a blank page or a backup.
dashboard.continueLatestHelp: Jump straight back into the app you changed most recently.
dashboard.pickUpEyebrow: PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
dashboard.planHelp: Your plan, how many apps you've made, and how many AI actions you've used this month. Click to see plan details.
dashboard.filterLiveHelp: Show only apps that are published, so visitors can open them.
dashboard.filterDraftHelp: Show only apps you haven't published yet. Visitors can't see these.
dashboard.searchHelp: Type part of an app's name to show only matching apps.
dashboard.clearSearchHelp: Clear the search and show your apps again.
dashboard.sortHelp: Choose the order of your apps: most recently changed first, or by name.
dashboard.firstAppDescribe: Describe it in the box above, or pick another way to start below.
dashboard.firstAppPick: An idea is all you need. Choose your favourite way to build below.
dashboard.exploreHelp: Scroll down to the different ways you can start a new app.
dashboard.clearFiltersHelp: Clear the search and filter so all your apps show again.
dashboard.openDesignerHelp: Open this app in the AI Designer to keep changing it.
dashboard.openPagesHelp: Open this app's pages so you can keep editing them.
dashboard.overviewHelp: Open this app's overview: its pages, automations (flows), data and publishing. Flows are automatic steps that run when something happens, like a form being sent.

dashboard.draftHelp: Draft: this app isn't published yet, so only you can see it.
dashboard.buildMobileHelp: Turn this app into a phone app for Android, iPhone and iPad.
dashboard.buildYourWayIntro: The same powerful tools. Your kind of starting point.
dashboard.ideaLabel: Describe the app you want to make
dashboard.ideaPlaceholder: e.g. Bookings for my dog walking business
dashboard.planMyAppHelp: The AI turns your idea, and any pictures you added, into a plan you can check before anything is built.

ai.title: Describe it
ai.label: From idea to app
ai.description: Say what you want in your own words. Check the plan, then get pages, data and working forms.
ai.help: Describe your app in a few words. The AI suggests a plan you can check and change, then builds the pages, forms and data for you.

template.title: Templates
template.label: A beautiful head start
template.description: Choose a ready-made design and make every detail your own.
template.help: Start from a finished design, like a shop or portfolio. You can change every word, picture and colour afterwards.

designer.title: AI Designer
designer.label: Create together
designer.description: Shape your idea through a conversation. Design, refine, and explore.
designer.help: Chat with the AI to design your app step by step. Ask for changes, click parts of the preview to comment, and go back to older versions.

clone.title: Copy a website
clone.label: Start with a URL
clone.description: Bring a website into your workspace, ready to personalise.
clone.help: Type the address of a website you own and copy up to 30 of its pages, with their pictures and styles, into a new app you can edit.

blank.title: Blank app
blank.label: Your canvas, your rules
blank.description: Build by hand with drag-and-drop blocks and ready-made features.
blank.help: Start from a simple welcome page and build the rest yourself by dragging blocks onto it. Best if you like to be fully in control.

import.title: Import an app
import.label: From a backup
import.description: Bring in an app from a backup .zip, from this server or another.
import.help: Upload a backup .zip of an app to make a new copy of it here, with its pages, data and pictures. The backup can come from this server or another one.

newPage.seePlansHelp: Compare plans that let you make more apps.

wizard.connectAi: Want people to build apps just by describing them? <link>Connect an AI model</link> in Settings. It works with hosted models or one running on your own computer.
wizard.connectAiHelp: Only admins see this link. Open Settings to connect the AI so people can create apps by describing them.
wizard.startSubheading: Pick a design you like. You can change every word, picture and colour afterwards.
wizard.backHelp: Go back to the start page to see every way to begin a new app.

start.seeAllHelp: Browse every ready-made design, with search and categories.
start.templateHelp: Preview this template and start an app from it. You can change every word, picture and colour afterwards.
start.designDetail: Chat with the AI Designer and shape your app step by step.
start.designHelp: Opens the AI Designer: describe your app, then keep asking for changes and see them in a live preview.
start.cloneDetail: Bring in a site you already have and make it editable.
start.cloneHelp: Type your website's address to copy up to 30 of its pages into a new app. Only copy sites you own or may use.
start.blankDetail: Build it yourself with drag-and-drop blocks.
start.blankHelp: Start from a simple welcome page and build the rest yourself in the drag-and-drop editor.
start.importDetail: From a backup .zip, made on this server or another one.
start.importHelp: Upload a backup .zip to get a new copy of that app, with its pages, data and pictures.

createForm.nameHelp: A name for your new app. You can change it later.
createForm.createHelp: Creates a new, empty app with this name and opens it.

blank.title: Start blank
blank.intro: Give your app a name. It starts with a simple welcome page (intro, about and contact sections) and sign-in pages, ready for you to change.
blank.nameHelp: A name for your new app. You can change it later. Press Enter to create it.
blank.createHelp: Creates an empty app with one home page and opens the editor so you can start adding blocks.

templates.heading: Pick a template
templates.subheading: Preview a starting point, name your app, and make it yours.
templates.closePreviewHelp: Close this preview and go back to the list of templates.
templates.includes: Includes the starter design and its working feature modules. You can change everything after creating your app.
templates.appNameHelp: What to call your new app. You can change it later.
templates.createHelp: Makes a new app with this design and its ready-made features, then opens the editor so you can change anything.
templates.searchHelp: Type a word like 'bakery' or 'booking' to find templates by name, description or tag.
templates.previewHelp: See a bigger preview of this template. Nothing is created until you choose to.

clone.badAddress: That doesn't look like a web address. Try something like mybusiness.com
clone.startFailed: We couldn't start copying that site. Please try again.
clone.incomplete: The copy stopped before it finished. Please try again.
clone.title: Copy your website
clone.intro: Brings up to 30 pages of your site, with their pictures and styles, into an app you can edit here. Only copy sites you own or have permission to use.
clone.addressHelp: The address of the website to copy, like mybusiness.com. You don't need to type https://.
clone.startHelp: Starts copying the site into a new app. It can take a minute; the editor opens by itself when it's done.
clone.copyingPages: Copying ({count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}})
clone.openWhenDone: We'll open the editor when it's done.
clone.stopHelp: Stop copying. Nothing is saved, so you can try again with a different address.
clone.unreachable: We couldn't reach that address. Check the spelling and that the site is online, then try again.
clone.noPages: We reached the site but couldn't copy any pages from it.
clone.failed: Something went wrong while copying. Please try again.

import.failed: Couldn't import that backup. Please try again.
import.title: Import an app
import.intro: Choose a backup .zip made with Publish → Download backup, on this server or another one. You get a copy of the app with its pages, workflows, data and images. App passwords aren't in backups, so people use “Forgot password” once.
import.fileHelp: Pick the backup .zip you downloaded from an app's Publish page. Backups made on another server work too.
import.name: New name (optional)
import.nameHelp: Give the imported app a different name. Leave empty to keep the name it had in the backup.
import.namePlaceholder: Keeps the original name if empty
import.submitHelp: Creates a new app from the backup. Your other apps aren't changed. The editor opens when it's ready.

modules.searchPlaceholder: Search features, like bookings or shop…
modules.searchHelp: Type what you want your app to do, like bookings, shop or reviews, to find a matching feature.
modules.clearSearchHelp: Clear the search and show every feature again.
modules.matches: {count, plural, one {# feature matches} other {# features match}}
modules.clearFiltersHelp: Clear the search and category so every feature shows again.
modules.addAgainHelp: Your app already has this. Click to add another separate copy, with its own pages and saved items.
modules.addHelp: Add this feature to your app. You may answer a few quick questions first, then its pages open so you can make them your own.
modules.addedHelp: Your app already has this feature. The number shows how many copies you've added.
modules.detailsHelp: See exactly what this feature adds to your app: how many pages, lists of saved items and automations.
modules.addsPages: Adds {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}.
modules.addsPagesTables: Adds {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}, {tables, plural, one {# list} other {# lists}} of saved items.
modules.addsPagesFlows: Adds {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} and {flows, plural, one {# flow} other {# flows}}.
modules.addsAll: Adds {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}, {tables, plural, one {# list} other {# lists}} of saved items and {flows, plural, one {# flow} other {# flows}}.
modules.needsAuth: Needs sign-in and accounts, which every new app already has.
modules.needsEmail: Needs email to be set up on the server.
modules.addFailed: Couldn't add this feature. Please try again.
modules.alreadyAdded: Already added. {name} is already in your app{count, plural, one {} other { (# copies)}}. Adding it again makes another copy, with its own pages and lists.
modules.nothingToFill: Nothing to fill in. We'll add its pages to your app, ready for you to change.
modules.needsFirstHelp: This feature needs that one to work. Add it first, then come back and add this one.
modules.installAgainHelp: Adds a second, separate copy of this feature with its own pages and saved items. The copy you already have isn't changed.
modules.installHelp: Adds this feature's pages, and any lists or automations it needs, to your app. You can change everything afterwards.
